-- Функция перетаскивания (оптимизирована под сенсорный ввод Delta)
local function dragify(Main)
	local dragToggle, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
	Main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = Main.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragToggle = false end
			end)
		end
	end)
	Main.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragToggle then
			local Delta = input.Position - dragStart
			local Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + Delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
			TweenService:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Position = Position}):Play()
		end
	end)
end
dragify(Frame)

end)

-- 2. ИЗМЕНЕНИЕ НЕБА (SKYBOX)

local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local TARGET_PLACE_ID = 123974602339071

_G.GenBytecode = true
_G.Settings = _G.Settings or {
    ['Time'] = 0.01
}

local function generateBytecode()
    local randomNum = math.random(256, 65535)
    if math.random(1, 2) == 1 then
        return string.format("0x%X", randomNum)
    else
        return string.format("0x%x", randomNum)
    end
end

local function sendChatMessage(message)
    local textChannels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
    local generalChannel = textChannels and textChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
    
    if generalChannel then
        generalChannel:SendAsync(message)
    else
        local defaultChatSystemChatEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        local sayMessageRequest = defaultChatSystemChatEvents and defaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
        if sayMessageRequest then
            sayMessageRequest:FireServer(message, "All")
        end
    end
end

local function setupEnvironment()
    local character = localPlayer.Character or localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 5, 100)
    part.Position = Vector3.new(-16, 5000, -34)
    part.Anchored = true
    part.Parent = workspace
    humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-16, 5001, -34)
end

local function serverHop()
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    local currentJobId = game.JobId
    
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        local serversUrl = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. placeId .. "/servers/0?sortOrder=2&excludeFullGames=true&limit=100"
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(serversUrl))
    end)
    
    if success and result and result.data then
        local validServers = {}
        for _, server in ipairs(result.data) do
            if server.id ~= currentJobId and server.playing < server.maxPlayers then
                table.insert(validServers, server.id)
            end
        end
        
        if #validServers > 0 then
            local randomServerId = validServers[math.random(1, #validServers)]
            TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, randomServerId, localPlayer)
            return
        end
    end
    
    TeleportService:Teleport(placeId, localPlayer)
end

local generatorThread = nil

local function startGenerator()
    if game.PlaceId ~= TARGET_PLACE_ID then
        return
    end

    if generatorThread then return end
    
    generatorThread = task.spawn(function()
        local waitTime = tonumber(_G.Settings['Time']) or 10
        if waitTime < 1 then
            setupEnvironment()
            
            local startTime = tick()
            while _G.GenBytecode and (tick() - startTime < 2) do
                local hexCode = generateBytecode()
                sendChatMessage(hexCode)
                task.wait(waitTime)
            end
            
            serverHop()
            generatorThread = nil
            return
        end
        
        while _G.GenBytecode do
            local hexCode = generateBytecode()
            sendChatMessage(hexCode)
            
            waitTime = tonumber(_G.Settings['Time']) or 10
            if waitTime < 1 then
                setupEnvironment()
                local startTime = tick()
                while _G.GenBytecode and (tick() - startTime < 2) do
                    local hex = generateBytecode()
                    sendChatMessage(hex)
                    task.wait(waitTime)
                end
                serverHop()
                break
            end
            
            task.wait(waitTime)
        end
        generatorThread = nil
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if _G.GenBytecode and game.PlaceId == TARGET_PLACE_ID then
            startGenerator()
        else
            generatorThread = nil
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

-- for beginners i made public
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Safe ScreenGui Parent
local function getSafeParent()
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return gethui and gethui() or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    if success and result then
        return result
    end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local ParentContainer = getSafeParent()

-- Cleanup Old Instances
if ParentContainer:FindFirstChild("SpinDashSelectionGui") then
    ParentContainer.SpinDashSelectionGui:Destroy()
end
if ParentContainer:FindFirstChild("SpinDashMainGui") then

end

-- ========================================================
-- 1. DEVICE SELECTION GUI
-- ========================================================
local SelectionGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
SelectionGui.Name = "SpinDashSelectionGui"
SelectionGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
SelectionGui.DisplayOrder = 999999

local Overlay = Instance.new("Frame")

end

-- ========================================================
-- 2. MAIN DASH BUTTON GUI
-- ========================================================
local MainGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

MainGui.Enabled = false
MainGui.DisplayOrder = 999999

local DashButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
DashButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DashButton.Text = "SPIN DASH"
DashButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
DashButton.Parent = MainGui

DashCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

DashStroke.Thickness = 2
DashStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
DashStroke.Parent = DashButton

-- Mode Handler
local function applyMode(isPhone)
    if isPhone then
        DashButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 35)
        DashButton.TextSize = 12
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0.75, -17)
    else
        DashButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 48)
        DashButton.TextSize = 16
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -65, 0.75, -24)
    end
    SelectionGui:Destroy()
    MainGui.Enabled = true
end

PhoneBtn.Activated:Connect(function() applyMode(true) end)
TabletBtn.Activated:Connect(function() applyMode(false) end)

-- Mobile & PC Draggable Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

DashButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = DashButton.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

DashButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- ========================================================
-- 3. SPIN DASH MECHANIC
-- ========================================================
local isDashing = false

local animR6 = Instance.new("Animation")
animR6.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://278828913"

local animR15 = Instance.new("Animation")
animR15.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://582855105"

local function performSpinDash()
    if isDashing then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not root then return end
    
    isDashing = true
    
    -- Load Animation safely
    local animTrack
    pcall(function()
        local animToPlay = (humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6) and animR6 or animR15
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
        animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animToPlay)
        animTrack:Play()
    end)
    
    -- Physics Setup
    local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    attachment.Parent = root
    
    local linearVel = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
    linearVel.Attachment0 = attachment
    linearVel.MaxForce = 999999
    linearVel.VectorVelocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 60
    linearVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    linearVel.Parent = root
    
    local angularVel = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
    angularVel.Attachment0 = attachment
    angularVel.MaxTorque = 999999
    angularVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)
    angularVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    angularVel.Parent = root
    
    task.wait(0.5)
    
    linearVel:Destroy()
    angularVel:Destroy()
    attachment:Destroy()
    
    if animTrack then
        pcall(function()
            animTrack:Stop()
            animTrack:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    
    isDashing = false
end

DashButton.Activated:Connect(performSpinDash)

local FLING_POWER, flingEnabled, SELF_PROTECTION, lastFlingTime = 16.5, false, true, {}

isValidTarget = function(targetCharacter)
    if not targetCharacter or targetCharacter == character then return false end
    local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetCharacter)
    if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == player then return false end
    local currentTime = tick()
    if lastFlingTime[targetPlayer.UserId] and (currentTime - lastFlingTime[targetPlayer.UserId]) < 0.5 then return false end
    return true, targetPlayer
end

flingTarget = function(targetCharacter)
    local isValid, targetPlayer = isValidTarget(targetCharacter)
    if not isValid then return end
    local targetRootPart, targetHumanoid = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not targetRootPart or not targetHumanoid then return end
    lastFlingTime[targetPlayer.UserId] = tick()
    local direction = (targetRootPart.Position - rootPart.Position).Unit
    local flingVelocity = direction * FLING_POWER * 50 + Vector3.new(0, FLING_POWER * 2, 0)
    targetRootPart.Velocity, targetRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flingVelocity, flingVelocity
    targetRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-50, 50), math.random(-50, 50), math.random(-50, 50))
    print("Flung:", targetCharacter.Name)
end

startFling = function()
    spawn(function()
        while flingEnabled do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if character and character.Parent then
                local currentRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if currentRootPart then
                    local originalVel = currentRootPart.Velocity
                    currentRootPart.Velocity = originalVel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    currentRootPart.Velocity = originalVel
                    RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                    currentRootPart.Velocity = originalVel + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

onTouched = function(hit)
    if not flingEnabled or not SELF_PROTECTION then return end
    local targetCharacter, targetHumanoid = hit.Parent, hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if targetHumanoid and targetCharacter ~= character then
        local hitBelongsToUs = false
        if character then
            for _, part in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if part == hit then hitBelongsToUs = true break end
            end
        end
        if not hitBelongsToUs then flingTarget(targetCharacter) end
    end
end

connectTouchEvents = function()
    if not character then return end
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.Touched:Connect(onTouched) end
    end
end

setupFlingSystem = function()

        print("Touch fling system ready for", player.Name)
        print("Self-protection:", SELF_PROTECTION and "ENABLED" or "DISABLED")

end

toggleFling = function()
    flingEnabled = not flingEnabled

emergencyStop = function() flingEnabled = false print("EMERGENCY STOP - Touch fling disabled!") end

if character and character.Parent then setupFlingSystem() end

local function safeDestroy(obj)
	if obj then
		pcall(function()
			obj:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

local function cf(x, y, z, rx, ry, rz)
	return CFrame.new(x, y, z)
		* CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad(rx or 0),
			math.rad(ry or 0),
			math.rad(rz or 0)
		)
end

--========================================================--
-- R15 / LIMB SETUP
--========================================================--

local function bindR15Part(fakeLimb, partName, yOffset)
	local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
	if not part then return end

	for _, obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
		if obj:IsA("Motor6D")
			or obj:IsA("Weld")
			or obj:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
			obj:Destroy()
		end
	end

	part.CFrame = fakeLimb.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, yOffset, 0)

	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = fakeLimb
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.Parent = fakeLimb
end

local function createFakeLimb(name, p1, p2, p3)
	local fake = Instance.new("Part")
	fake.Name = name
	fake.Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
	fake.Transparency = 1
	fake.CanCollide = false
	fake.CanTouch = false
	fake.CanQuery = false
	fake.Massless = true
	fake.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame
	fake.Parent = character

	table.insert(fakeLimbs, fake)

	if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
		bindR15Part(fake, p1, 0.4)
		bindR15Part(fake, p2, -0.2)
		bindR15Part(fake, p3, -0.85)
	else
		bindR15Part(fake, p1, 0)
	end

	return fake
end

--========================================================--
-- REALISTIC LAUGH ANIMATION
--========================================================--

local function getLaughAnimation(time)
	-- Main laugh rhythm
	local laughCycle = math.sin(time * 8)
	local laughFast = math.sin(time * 17)
	local laughSoft = math.sin(time * 4)

	-- Stronger movement during the laugh
	local bounce = math.abs(math.sin(time * 8)) * 0.10

	-- Body naturally leans forward while laughing
	local torso =
		CFrame.new(
			0,
			bounce,
			0
		)
		* CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad(-8 + laughCycle * 5),
			math.rad(laughSoft * 2),
			math.rad(laughCycle * 3)
		)

	-- Hands move toward the mouth/chin instead of staying frozen
	local rightArm =
		cf(
			0.65,
			1.05 + math.abs(laughCycle) * 0.08,
			-0.55,
			-105 + laughCycle * 12,
			-18 + laughFast * 4,
			28 + laughCycle * 10
		)

	local leftArm =
		cf(
			-0.65,
			1.05 + math.abs(laughCycle) * 0.08,
			-0.55,
			-105 - laughCycle * 12,
			18 - laughFast * 4,
			-28 - laughCycle * 10
		)

	-- Slight leg movement makes the laugh feel less robotic
	local rightLeg =
		cf(
			0.5,
			-1.9 + math.abs(laughCycle) * 0.04,
			0,
			laughCycle * 4,
			0,
			0
		)

	local leftLeg =
		cf(
			-0.5,
			-1.9 + math.abs(laughCycle) * 0.04,
			0,
			-laughCycle * 4,
			0,
			0
		)

	-- Head movement follows the laugh rhythm
	local neck =
		CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad(-8 + math.abs(laughCycle) * 4),
			math.rad(laughSoft * 4),
			math.rad(laughCycle * 3)
		)

	return torso, rightArm, leftArm, rightLeg, leftLeg, neck
end

--========================================================--
-- NORMAL ANIMATION SYSTEM
--========================================================--

local function getAnimation(time, moving, state)
	local torsoTilt = CFrame.new()
	local rArm = cf(1.45, 0.1, 0)
	local lArm = cf(-1.45, 0.1, 0)
	local rLeg = cf(0.5, -1.9, 0)
	local lLeg = cf(-0.5, -1.9, 0)
	local neck = CFrame.new()

	local isJumping = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
	local isFreefall = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall

	--====================================================--
	-- REALISTIC LAUGH
	--====================================================--

	if isLaughing then
		return getLaughAnimation(time)

	--====================================================--
	-- ATTACK
	--====================================================--

	elseif isAttacking then
		torsoTilt = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(30), 0, 0)

		rArm = cf(
			1.2,
			0.5,
			-0.5,
			-90,
			0,
			30
		)

		lArm = cf(
			-1.2,
			0.5,
			-0.5,
			-90,
			0,
			-30
		)

	--====================================================--
	-- JUMP
	--====================================================--

	elseif isJumping or isFreefall then
		torsoTilt = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), 0, 0)

		rArm = cf(
			1.4,
			1.0,
			0,
			-110,
			0,
			20
		)

		lArm = cf(
			-1.4,
			1.0,
			0,
			-110,
			0,
			-20
		)

		rLeg = cf(
			0.5,
			-1.5,
			-0.3,
			20,
			0,
			0
		)

		lLeg = cf(
			-0.5,
			-1.5,
			0.3,
			-20,
			0,
			0
		)

	--====================================================--
	-- RUN
	--====================================================--

	elseif moving then
		if isSprinting then
			local runCycle = math.sin(time * 10)
			local bob = math.abs(math.sin(time * 10)) * 0.3

			torsoTilt =
				CFrame.new(0, bob, 0)
				* CFrame.Angles(
					0,
					0,
					math.rad(runCycle * 6)
				)

			rArm = cf(
				1.4,
				-0.3,
				0.6,
				45 - runCycle * 40,
				0,
				15
			)

			lArm = cf(
				-1.4,
				-0.3,
				0.6,
				45 + runCycle * 40,
				0,
				-15
			)

			local rLegY = runCycle > 0 and runCycle * 0.5 or 0
			local lLegY = runCycle < 0 and -runCycle * 0.5 or 0

			rLeg = cf(
				0.5,
				-1.9 + rLegY,
				-runCycle * 0.9,
				runCycle * 70,
				0,
				0
			)

			lLeg = cf(
				-0.5,
				-1.9 + lLegY,
				runCycle * 0.9,
				-runCycle * 70,
				0,
				0
			)

		else
			local walkCycle = math.sin(time * 6)

			torsoTilt =
				CFrame.Angles(
					math.rad(-3),
					0,
					math.rad(walkCycle * 3)
				)

			rArm = cf(
				1.4,
				0.1,
				0,
				-walkCycle * 25,
				0,
				10
			)

			lArm = cf(
				-1.4,
				0.1,
				0,
				walkCycle * 25,
				0,
				-10
			)

			local rLegY = walkCycle > 0 and walkCycle * 0.3 or 0
			local lLegY = walkCycle < 0 and -walkCycle * 0.3 or 0

			rLeg = cf(
				0.5,
				-1.9 + rLegY,
				-walkCycle * 0.4,
				walkCycle * 30,
				0,
				0
			)

			lLeg = cf(
				-0.5,
				-1.9 + lLegY,
				walkCycle * 0.4,
				-walkCycle * 30,
				0,
				0
			)
		end

	--====================================================--
	-- IDLE
	--====================================================--

	else
		local breathe = math.sin(time * 3) * 0.03

		torsoTilt =
			CFrame.new(
				0,
				breathe,
				0
			)

		if handCoveringFace then
			rArm = cf(
				0.25,
				1.35,
				-0.35,
				-135,
				25,
				-15
			)

			lArm = cf(
				-0.25,
				1.35,
				-0.35,
				-135,
				-25,
				15
			)
		else
			rArm = cf(
				1.3,
				-0.05,
				0,
				5,
				0,
				10
			)

			lArm = cf(
				-1.3,
				-0.05,
				0,
				5,
				0,
				-10
			)
		end
	end

	return torsoTilt, rArm, lArm, rLeg, lLeg, neck
end

local function showFloatingChatText(msg)
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end

	local oldBg = head:FindFirstChild("FloatingChatText")

	if oldBg then
		oldBg:Destroy()
	end

	local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bg.Name = "FloatingChatText"
	bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 80)
	bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
	bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bg.Parent = head

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = 20
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.Text = ""
	label.Parent = bg

	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, #msg do
			if not bg.Parent then
				break
			end

			label.Text = string.sub(msg, 1, i)

			local sfx = Instance.new("Sound")
			sfx.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6467449877"
			sfx.Volume = 0.6
			sfx.Pitch = math.random(90, 110) / 100
			sfx.Parent = head
			sfx:Play()

			Debris:AddItem(sfx, 1)

			task.wait(0.04)
		end

		task.wait(4)

		if bg.Parent then
			bg:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while bg.Parent do
			label.Position = UDim2.new(
				0,
				math.random(-3, 3),
				0,
				math.random(-3, 3)
			)

			task.wait(0.04)
		end
	end)
end

local function sendChatMessage(msg)
	showFloatingChatText(msg)

	if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
		local channel =
			TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

		if channel then
			channel:SendAsync(msg)
		end
	else
		local events =
			ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(
				"DefaultChatSystemChatEvents"
			)

		if events then
			local remote =
				events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")

			if remote then
				remote:FireServer(msg, "All")
			end
		end
	end
end

local function triggerLaugh()
	if not running or isLaughing then
		return
	end

	isLaughing = true

	-- Laugh sound
	local sfx = Instance.new("Sound")
	sfx.Name = "RealisticLaugh"
	sfx.SoundId = "rbxassetid://109263303377273"
	sfx.Volume = 2.5
	sfx.PlaybackSpeed = 1
	sfx.Parent = rootPart
	sfx:Play()

	local connection

	connection = sfx.Ended:Connect(function()
		isLaughing = false

		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
			connection = nil
		end
	end)

	-- Safety timeout
	task.delay(5, function()
		if isLaughing then
			isLaughing = false

			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
				connection = nil
			end
		end
	end)

	Debris:AddItem(sfx, 6)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(
	input,
	gameProcessed
)
	if gameProcessed or not running then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then

		sendRandomChat()

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then

		triggerLaugh()

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then

		handCoveringFace =
			not handCoveringFace

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then

		isSprinting = not isSprinting

		if humanoid then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed =
				isSprinting
				and SPRINT_SPEED
				or NORMAL_SPEED
		end

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then

		triggerAttack()

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then

		isTotalGlitch =
			not isTotalGlitch

		if isTotalGlitch then

			if not glitchSound and rootPart then
				glitchSound =
					Instance.new("Sound")

				glitchSound.SoundId =
					"rbxassetid://97749286438268"

				glitchSound.Volume = 3
				glitchSound.Looped = true
				glitchSound.Parent = rootPart
				glitchSound:Play()
			end

		else

			if glitchSound then
				glitchSound:Stop()
				glitchSound:Destroy()
				glitchSound = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

--========================================================--
-- DRAGGABLE GUI
--========================================================--

local function makeDraggable(gui)
	local dragToggle = false
	local dragStart
	local startPos

	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ==
				Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType ==
				Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState ==
					Enum.UserInputState.End then

					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragToggle and
			(
				input.UserInputType ==
					Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				or
				input.UserInputType ==
					Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			) then

			local delta =
				input.Position - dragStart

			gui.Position =
				UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale,
					startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
					startPos.Y.Scale,
					startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
				)
		end
	end)
end

--========================================================--
-- START SYSTEM
--========================================================--

local function startAnimation()
	if running then
		return
	end

	if not character then
		character = player.Character
	end

	humanoid =
		character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	rootPart =
		character:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if not humanoid or not rootPart then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(
			RENDER_NAME
		)
	end)

	local head =
		character:FindFirstChild("Head")

	if head then
		camera.CameraSubject = head
	end

	local isR15 =
		humanoid.RigType ==
		Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15

	--====================================================--
	-- JOINTS
	--====================================================--

	if isR15 then

		rootJoint =
			character:FindFirstChild(
				"LowerTorso"
			)
			and character.LowerTorso:FindFirstChild(
				"Root"
			)
			or rootPart:FindFirstChild(
				"RootJoint"
			)

		local upperTorso =
			character:FindFirstChild(
				"UpperTorso"
			)

		if upperTorso then
			neckJoint =
				upperTorso:FindFirstChild(
					"Neck"
				)
		end

		rightArm =
			createFakeLimb(
				"RightArm",
				"RightUpperArm",
				"RightLowerArm",
				"RightHand"
			)

		leftArm =
			createFakeLimb(
				"LeftArm",
				"LeftUpperArm",
				"LeftLowerArm",
				"LeftHand"
			)

		rightLeg =
			createFakeLimb(
				"RightLeg",
				"RightUpperLeg",
				"RightLowerLeg",
				"RightFoot"
			)

		leftLeg =
			createFakeLimb(
				"LeftLeg",
				"LeftUpperLeg",
				"LeftLowerLeg",
				"LeftFoot"
			)

	else

		rootJoint =
			rootPart:FindFirstChild(
				"RootJoint"
			)

		local torsoPart =
			character:FindFirstChild(
				"Torso"
			)

		if torsoPart then
			neckJoint =
				torsoPart:FindFirstChild(
					"Neck"
				)

			for _, name in ipairs({
				"Right Shoulder",
				"Left Shoulder",
				"Right Hip",
				"Left Hip"
			}) do

				local joint =
					torsoPart:FindFirstChild(
						name
					)

				if joint then
					joint:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		rightArm =
			createFakeLimb(
				"RightArm",
				"Right Arm"
			)

		leftArm =
			createFakeLimb(
				"LeftArm",
				"Left Arm"
			)

		rightLeg =
			createFakeLimb(
				"RightLeg",
				"Right Leg"
			)

		leftLeg =
			createFakeLimb(
				"LeftLeg",
				"Left Leg"
			)
	end

	-- Save original joints
	if rootJoint then
		originalRootC0 = rootJoint.C0
	end

	if neckJoint then
		originalNeckC0 = neckJoint.C0
	end

	humanoid.WalkSpeed =
		isSprinting
		and SPRINT_SPEED
		or NORMAL_SPEED

	humanoid.AutoRotate = true

	currTorso = CFrame.new()

	currRArm =
		cf(1.45, 0.1, 0)

	currLArm =
		cf(-1.45, 0.1, 0)

	currRLeg =
		cf(0.5, -1.9, 0)

	currLLeg =
		cf(-0.5, -1.9, 0)

	currNeck = CFrame.new()

	running = true
	isTrembling = false

	nextTremorTrigger =
		os.clock()
		+ math.random(10, 30) / 10

	showKeybindsDisplay()

	--====================================================--
	-- RENDER LOOP
	--====================================================--

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(
		RENDER_NAME,
		Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 1,
		function(dt)

			if not running
				or not humanoid
				or humanoid.Health <= 0
				or not rootPart then
				return
			end

			local now = os.clock()

			local moving =
				humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude
				> 0.05

			local state =
				humanoid:GetState()

			-- Random tremor
			if not isTrembling then

				if now >= nextTremorTrigger then
					isTrembling = true
					tremorStartTime = now
				end

			else

				if now - tremorStartTime >= 0.4 then
					isTrembling = false

					nextTremorTrigger =
						now
						+ math.random(10, 30) / 10
				end
			end

			local torsoTilt
			local targetRight
			local targetLeft
			local targetRLeg
			local targetLLeg
			local targetNeck

			torsoTilt,
			targetRight,
			targetLeft,
			targetRLeg,
			targetLLeg,
			targetNeck =
				getAnimation(
					now,
					moving,
					state
				)

			-- Laugh animation gets a smoother blend
			local animSmooth =
				isLaughing
				and 0.18
				or 0.25

			currTorso =
				currTorso:Lerp(
					torsoTilt,
					animSmooth
				)

			currRArm =
				currRArm:Lerp(
					targetRight,
					animSmooth
				)

			currLArm =
				currLArm:Lerp(
					targetLeft,
					animSmooth
				)

			currRLeg =
				currRLeg:Lerp(
					targetRLeg,
					animSmooth
				)

			currLLeg =
				currLLeg:Lerp(
					targetLLeg,
					animSmooth
				)

			currNeck =
				currNeck:Lerp(
					targetNeck,
					animSmooth
				)

			-- Apply torso
			if rootJoint
				and originalRootC0 then

				rootJoint.C0 =
					originalRootC0
					* currTorso
			end

			-- Apply head movement during laugh
			if neckJoint
				and originalNeckC0 then

				neckJoint.C0 =
					originalNeckC0
					* currNeck
			end

			local bodyBase =
				rootPart.CFrame
				* currTorso

			local tremorRA =
				Vector3.new()

			local tremorLA =
				Vector3.new()

			local tremorRL =
				Vector3.new()

			local tremorLL =
				Vector3.new()

			--================================================--
			-- TOTAL GLITCH
			--================================================--

			if isTotalGlitch then

				local glitchX =
					math.random(-40, 40) / 10

				local glitchY =
					math.random(-30, 30) / 10

				local glitchZ =
					math.random(-40, 40) / 10

				tremorRA =
					Vector3.new(
						glitchX,
						glitchY,
						glitchZ
					)

				tremorLA =
					Vector3.new(
						-glitchX,
						glitchY,
						-glitchZ
					)

				tremorRL =
					Vector3.new(
						glitchX,
						-glitchY,
						glitchZ
					)

				tremorLL =
					Vector3.new(
						-glitchX,
						-glitchY,
						-glitchZ
					)

			--================================================--
			-- RANDOM TREMOR
			--================================================--

			elseif isTrembling then

				local t = now * 25
				local amp = 0.4

				tremorRA =
					Vector3.new(
						math.noise(t, 1, 1) * amp,
						math.noise(1, t, 1) * amp,
						math.noise(1, 1, t) * amp
					)

				tremorLA =
					Vector3.new(
						math.noise(t, 2, 2) * amp,
						math.noise(2, t, 2) * amp,
						math.noise(2, 2, t) * amp
					)

				tremorRL =
					Vector3.new(
						math.noise(t, 3, 3) * amp,
						math.noise(3, t, 3) * amp,
						math.noise(3, 3, t) * amp
					)

				tremorLL =
					Vector3.new(
						math.noise(t, 4, 4) * amp,
						math.noise(4, t, 4) * amp,
						math.noise(4, 4, t) * amp
					)
			end

			--================================================--
			-- APPLY LIMBS
			--================================================--

			if rightArm then
				rightArm.CFrame =
					bodyBase
					* currRArm
					+ tremorRA

				rightArm.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end

			if leftArm then
				leftArm.CFrame =
					bodyBase
					* currLArm
					+ tremorLA

				leftArm.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end

			if rightLeg then
				rightLeg.CFrame =
					bodyBase
					* currRLeg
					+ tremorRL

				rightLeg.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end

			if leftLeg then
				leftLeg.CFrame =
					bodyBase
					* currLLeg
					+ tremorLL

				leftLeg.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end
		end
	)
end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local CHAT_COMMAND = "-net"
local ZERO_WEIGHT_PHYSICS = PhysicalProperties.new(0.0001, 0, 0, 0, 0)

local function sendInstantNet()
    task.spawn(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local textChannels = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels", 3)
            local generalChannel = textChannels and textChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if generalChannel then
                pcall(function()
                    generalChannel:SendAsync(CHAT_COMMAND)
                end)
                return
            end
        end

        local chatEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        if chatEvents then
            local sayRequest = chatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if sayRequest and sayRequest:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                pcall(function()
                    sayRequest:FireServer(CHAT_COMMAND, "All")
                end)
                return
            end
        end
    end)
end

sendInstantNet()

local activeConnections = {}

local function clearConnections()
    for _, conn in ipairs(activeConnections) do
        if conn and typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(activeConnections)
end

local function applyLockedHairSystem(character)
    clearConnections()

    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    local realHead = character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)

    if not humanoid or not realHead then
        warn("[HairLock] Testa o Humanoid non rilevati in tempo.")
        return
    end

    task.wait(0.2)

    local detectedHairs = {}

    local headHairAttachment = realHead:FindFirstChild("HairAttachment") or realHead:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment")

    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") then
            local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle then
                local isHairType = false
                if item.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
                    isHairType = true
                end

                local hairAttachment = handle:FindFirstChild("HairAttachment")
                local hatAttachment = handle:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment")

                if isHairType or hairAttachment or hatAttachment then
                    handle.Massless = true
                    handle.CanCollide = false
                    handle.CanTouch = false
                    handle.CanQuery = false
                    handle.Anchored = false
                    handle.CustomPhysicalProperties = ZERO_WEIGHT_PHYSICS

                    local chosenAttachment = hairAttachment or hatAttachment
                    local relativeOffset = CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 0)

                    if headHairAttachment and chosenAttachment then
                        relativeOffset = headHairAttachment.CFrame * chosenAttachment.CFrame:Inverse()
                    end

                    table.insert(detectedHairs, {
                        accessory = item,
                        handle = handle,
                        offset = relativeOffset
                    })

                    local ancestryConn = item.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, newParent)
                        if newParent ~= character and character.Parent then
                            task.defer(function()
                                item.Parent = character
                                handle.Parent = item
                                handle.Anchored = false
                            end)
                        end
                    end)
                    table.insert(activeConnections, ancestryConn)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if #detectedHairs == 0 then
        warn("[HairLock] Nessun accessorio per capelli trovato sul personaggio.")
        return
    end

    local function getActiveHead()
        for _, model in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if model:IsA("Model") and model ~= character and model:FindFirstChild("Head") and model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                if string.find(model.Name, localPlayer.Name) or model.Name == "CatwareRig" or model.Name == "Dummy" then
                    return model.Head
                end
            end
        end
        return realHead
    end

    local renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local targetHead = getActiveHead()
        if not targetHead or not targetHead.Parent then return end

        for _, hairData in ipairs(detectedHairs) do
            local handle = hairData.handle
            if handle and handle.Parent then
                handle.CFrame = targetHead.CFrame * hairData.offset

                if handle.Transparency > 0 then
                    handle.Transparency = 0
                end

                if handle.LocalTransparencyModifier > 0 then
                    handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    table.insert(activeConnections, renderConn)

    local stepConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        local targetHead = getActiveHead()
        if not targetHead or not targetHead.Parent then return end

        for _, hairData in ipairs(detectedHairs) do
            local handle = hairData.handle
            if handle and handle.Parent then
                if handle.Anchored then
                    handle.Anchored = false
                end

                if handle.CanCollide then
                    handle.CanCollide = false
                end

                handle.CFrame = targetHead.CFrame * hairData.offset
                handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = targetHead.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = targetHead.AssemblyAngularVelocity
            end
        end
    end)
    table.insert(activeConnections, stepConn)
end

if localPlayer.Character then
    task.spawn(applyLockedHairSystem, localPlayer.Character)
end

localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    sendInstantNet()
    task.spawn(applyLockedHairSystem, newCharacter)
end)

scripts.script:
--[[
    Community Accessory Orbit
    -------------------------
    Simple equipped-accessory orbit with the Source -30 netless-style write.

    Important:
    Source -30 helps keep locally owned accessory physics stable in experiences
    where the client retains ownership. It does not guarantee replication or
    protection in every game; the server still has final authority.

    Controls:
      RightShift  - show / hide menu
      Toggle      - orbit currently equipped accessories
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
if not LP then return end

local SOURCE_VELOCITY = Vector3.new(-30, 0, 0)

local ORBIT_RADIUS = 5.5
local ORBIT_HEIGHT = 1.25
local ORBIT_SPEED = 1.35
local ITEM_SPIN_SPEED = 1.8
local RESCAN_INTERVAL = 0.25

local GUI_NAME = "CommunityAccessoryOrbit"
local ENV_KEY = "__CommunityAccessoryOrbitUnload"

local env = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
if type(env[ENV_KEY]) == "function" then
    pcall(env[ENV_KEY])
end

local playerGui = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild(GUI_NAME)
if old then old:Destroy() end

local alive = true
local orbitEnabled = false
local orbitClock = 0
local lastScan = 0

local records = {}
local connections = {}

local function track(c)
    connections[#connections + 1] = c
    return c
end

local function character()
    return LP.Character
end

local function rootPart()
    local char = character()
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function accessoryJoints(char, accessory, handle)
    local out = {}
    if not (char and accessory and handle) then return out end

    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("JointInstance") or obj:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
            local ok, p0, p1 = pcall(function()
                return obj.Part0, obj.Part1
            end)

            if ok and (p0 == handle or p1 == handle) then
                local other = (p0 == handle) and p1 or p0
                if other
                    and other:IsA("BasePart")
                    and other:IsDescendantOf(char)
                    and not other:IsDescendantOf(accessory)
                then
                    out[#out + 1] = {
                        joint = obj,
                        parent = obj.Parent,
                    }
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function detachRecord(record)
    local handle = record.handle
    if not (handle and handle.Parent) then return end

    for _, info in ipairs(record.joints) do
        if info.joint and info.joint.Parent then
            info.joint.Parent = nil
        end
    end

    handle.Anchored = false
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.CanTouch = false
    handle.CanQuery = false
    handle.Massless = true
end

local function restoreRecord(record)
    local handle = record.handle

    if handle and handle.Parent then
        pcall(function()
            handle.CanCollide = record.canCollide
            handle.CanTouch = record.canTouch
            handle.CanQuery = record.canQuery
            handle.Massless = record.massless
        end)
    end

    for _, info in ipairs(record.joints) do
        if info.joint
            and info.joint.Parent == nil
            and info.parent
            and info.parent.Parent
        then
            pcall(function()
                info.joint.Parent = info.parent
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function addAccessory(accessory)
    if records[accessory] then return records[accessory] end
    if not accessory:IsA("Accessory") then return nil end

    local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not (handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil end

    local char = character()
    if not char then return nil end

    local record = {
        accessory = accessory,
        handle = handle,
        joints = accessoryJoints(char, accessory, handle),

        canCollide = handle.CanCollide,
        canTouch = handle.CanTouch,
        canQuery = handle.CanQuery,
        massless = handle.Massless,
    }

    records[accessory] = record

    if orbitEnabled then
        detachRecord(record)
    end

    return record
end

local function scanAccessories()
    local char = character()
    if not char then return end

    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") then
            addAccessory(child)
        end
    end

    for accessory, record in pairs(records) do
        if not accessory.Parent or not accessory:IsDescendantOf(char) then
            records[accessory] = nil
        elseif record.handle and record.handle.Parent then
            -- Keep body welds from being silently recreated.
            local newJoints = accessoryJoints(char, accessory, record.handle)
            for _, info in ipairs(newJoints) do
                local known = false
                for _, oldInfo in ipairs(record.joints) do
                    if oldInfo.joint == info.joint then
                        known = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not known then
                    record.joints[#record.joints + 1] = info
                end
            end

            if orbitEnabled then
                detachRecord(record)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function recordList()
    local list = {}
    for _, record in pairs(records) do
        if record.handle and record.handle.Parent then
            list[#list + 1] = record
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        return a.accessory.Name < b.accessory.Name
    end)
    return list
end

local function applySource30(handle)
    if not (handle and handle.Parent) then return end

    -- Keep these AFTER every CFrame / physics operation.
    -- This is the actual "Source -30" part.
    handle.Velocity = SOURCE_VELOCITY
    handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = SOURCE_VELOCITY
end

local function updateOrbit(dt)
    if not orbitEnabled then return end

    local root = rootPart()
    if not root then return end

    orbitClock += dt * ORBIT_SPEED

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastScan >= RESCAN_INTERVAL then
        lastScan = now
        scanAccessories()
    end

    local list = recordList()
    local count = #list
    if count == 0 then return end

    for index, record in ipairs(list) do
        local handle = record.handle
        if handle and handle.Parent then
            detachRecord(record)

            local angle = orbitClock + ((index - 1) / count) * math.pi * 2
            local localOffset = Vector3.new(
                math.cos(angle) * ORBIT_RADIUS,
                ORBIT_HEIGHT + math.sin(angle * 2) * 0.35,
                math.sin(angle) * ORBIT_RADIUS
            )

            local worldPosition = root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localOffset)
            local spin = orbitClock * ITEM_SPIN_SPEED + index * 0.35

            handle.CFrame =
                CFrame.new(worldPosition)
                * CFrame.Angles(
                    math.sin(angle) * 0.22,
                    -angle + math.pi * 0.5,
                    spin
                )

            handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

            -- FINAL velocity write.
            applySource30(handle)
        end
    end
end

local function setOrbit(on)
    orbitEnabled = on == true

    if orbitEnabled then
        orbitClock = 0
        lastScan = 0
        scanAccessories()

        for _, record in pairs(records) do
            detachRecord(record)
            applySource30(record.handle)
        end
    else

        end
    end

scripts.features:
A lightweight community accessory orbit built around the Source -30 method.

Equipped accessories are detached and driven in a live orbit around your character while the script continuously watches for newly equipped accessories and recreated body welds. Source Vector3.new(-30, 0, 0) is kept as the final velocity write each Heartbeat to help keep accessory physics stable when the client retains network ownership.

The goal of this release is to expose the Source -30 technique in a small, readable script instead of hiding it inside a massive hub.
Includes a compact draggable menu with orbit controls, radius adjustment, speed adjustment, automatic accessory rescanning, weld guarding, collision/touch disabling, respawn handling, and clean unload/re-execution support.
Replication and physics behavior are experience-dependent; the server still has final authority.
Features
- Source -30 accessory physics method
- Live accessory orbit
- Automatic equipped-accessory detection
- Continuously rescans for new accessories
- Detects and detaches recreated accessory welds
- Collision disabled while orbiting
- Touch disabled while orbiting
- Source -30 applied as the final Heartbeat velocity write
- Adjustable orbit radius
- Adjustable orbit speed
- Individual accessory spinning
- Orbit bobbing/motion
- Supports multiple equipped accessories automatically
- Restores accessory joints when orbit is disabled
- Respawn handling
- Draggable compact GUI
- Right Shift menu hide/show
- Safe re-execution/unload handling
- No loadstrings
- Standalone script
- Clean community-oriented source
- Open source / easy to modify

		if string.find(lower, "hat")
			or string.find(lower, "hair")
			or string.find(lower, "head")
			or string.find(lower, "face")
			or string.find(lower, "neck") then

		end
	end

	for _, v in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Attachment") then v:Destroy() end
	end

	local fake = Instance.new("Part", character)
	fake.Name = isHat and "HatController" or "SwordController"
	fake.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
	fake.Transparency = 1
	fake.CanCollide = false
	fake.Massless = true
	fake.CFrame = rootPart and rootPart.CFrame or character.PrimaryPart.CFrame

	for _, v in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("JointInstance")
			or v:IsA("Motor6D")
			or v:IsA("Weld")
			or v:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end

	handle.Parent = fake
	handle.CFrame = fake.CFrame

	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", fake)
	weld.Part0 = fake
	weld.Part1 = handle

	accessory:Destroy()
	table.insert(fakeLimbs, fake)

	if isHat then
		table.insert(spinningHats, { part = fake, realAccessory = handle })
	else
		table.insert(activeSwords, { part = fake, realAccessory = handle })
	end

	createTrail(fake)
end

--========================================================--
-- ANIMATION SYSTEM (BRAÇOS E ESPADAS PARA O CÉU)
--========================================================--

local function getAnimation(time, moving)
	local torsoTilt = CFrame.new()
	local rArm = cf(1.45, 0.1, 0)
	local lArm = cf(-1.45, 0.1, 0)
	local rLeg = cf(0.5, -1.9, 0)
	local lLeg = cf(-0.5, -1.9, 0)

	local breathe = math.sin(time * 2.1)
	local sway = math.sin(time * 1.35)
	local sway2 = math.cos(time * 1.35)

	if not moving then
		torsoTilt = CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad(breathe * 0.8),
			math.rad(sway * 1),
			math.rad(sway2 * 0.8)
		)

		if heldSword then
			rArm = cf(1.3, 0.5, 0, -90, 0, 0)
			lArm = cf(-1.3, -0.05, 0, 10, 0, -18)
		elseif #heldSwords > 0 then
			rArm = cf(1.3, 0.5, 0, -90, 0, 0)
			lArm = cf(-1.3, 0.5, 0, -90, 0, 0)
		else
			rArm = cf(1.3, -0.05, 0, 5 + breathe * 2, 0, 12)
			lArm = cf(-1.3, -0.05, 0, 5 - breathe * 2, 0, -12)
		end
	else
		local walkCycle = math.sin(time * 10)
		torsoTilt = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), 0, math.rad(sway * 2))

		if heldSword then
			rArm = cf(1.4, 0.5, 0, -90, 0, 0)
			lArm = cf(-1.4, 0.1, 0, walkCycle * 40, 0, -10)
		elseif #heldSwords > 0 then
			rArm = cf(1.4, 0.5, 0, -90, 0, 0)
			lArm = cf(-1.4, 0.5, 0, -90, 0, 0)
		else
			rArm = cf(1.4, 0.1, 0, -walkCycle * 40, 0, 10)
			lArm = cf(-1.4, 0.1, 0, walkCycle * 40, 0, -10)
		end

		local rLegY = walkCycle > 0 and walkCycle * 0.3 or 0
		local lLegY = walkCycle < 0 and -walkCycle * 0.3 or 0

		rLeg = cf(0.5, -1.9 + rLegY, -walkCycle * 0.5, walkCycle * 45, 0, 0)
		lLeg = cf(-0.5, -1.9 + lLegY, walkCycle * 0.5, -walkCycle * 45, 0, 0)
	end

	return torsoTilt, rArm, lArm, rLeg, lLeg
end

--========================================================--
-- BEYBLADE LAUNCHER SYSTEM
--========================================================--

local function triggerBeybladeLaunch()
	if isBeyblading or #heldSwords < 2 then return end
	isBeyblading = true

	task.spawn(function()
		local startPos = rootPart.Position
		local lookDir = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
		local maxDist = 35
		local duration = 1.2
		local startTime = os.clock()

		while os.clock() - startTime < duration do
			local alpha = (os.clock() - startTime) / duration
			local currentDist = math.sin(alpha * math.pi) * maxDist
			local spinSpeed = os.clock() * 35

			for i, sw in ipairs(heldSwords) do
				if sw and sw.part and sw.part.Parent then
					local sideOffset = (i == 1) and 2 or -2
					local targetPos = startPos + (lookDir * currentDist) + Vector3.new(sideOffset, 2, 0)
					sw.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, spinSpeed * (i == 1 and 1 or -1), math.rad(90))
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.016)
		end

		isBeyblading = false
	end)
end

--========================================================--
-- DRAGGABLE GUI
--========================================================--

local function makeDraggable(gui)
	local dragToggle = false
	local dragStart, startPos

	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragToggle and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			gui.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end

local function startAnimation()
	if running then return end
	if not character then character = player.Character end

	humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not rootPart then return end

	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(RENDER_NAME) end)

	for _, trail in ipairs(limbTrails) do safeDestroy(trail) end
	limbTrails = {}

	local isR15 = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15

	if isR15 then
		rootJoint = character:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") and character.LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Root") or rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")
		rightArm = createFakeLimb("RightArm", "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand")
		leftArm = createFakeLimb("LeftArm", "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand")
		rightLeg = createFakeLimb("RightLeg", "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot")
		leftLeg = createFakeLimb("LeftLeg", "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot")
	else
		rootJoint = rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")
		rightArm = createFakeLimb("RightArm", "Right Arm")
		leftArm = createFakeLimb("LeftArm", "Left Arm")
		rightLeg = createFakeLimb("RightLeg", "Right Leg")
		leftLeg = createFakeLimb("LeftLeg", "Left Leg")
		local torsoPart = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		if torsoPart then
			for _, name in ipairs({"Right Shoulder", "Left Shoulder", "Right Hip", "Left Hip"}) do
				local j = torsoPart:FindFirstChild(name)
				if j then j:Destroy() end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Accessory") then setupAccessory(child) end
	end
	listenForNewAccessories()

	if rootJoint then originalRootC0 = rootJoint.C0 end

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = NORMAL_SPEED
	humanoid.AutoRotate = true

	currTorso = CFrame.new()
	currRArm = cf(1.45, 0.1, 0)
	currLArm = cf(-1.45, 0.1, 0)
	currRLeg = cf(0.5, -1.9, 0)
	currLLeg = cf(-0.5, -1.9, 0)

	running = true

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(RENDER_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 1, function(dt)
		if not running or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not rootPart then return end

		local now = os.clock()
		local moving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05

		local torsoTilt, targetRight, targetLeft, targetRLeg, targetLLeg = getAnimation(now, moving)

		local shakeOffset = CFrame.new()
		if not moving then
			local twitchCycle = now % 2
			if twitchCycle < 0.15 then
				shakeOffset = CFrame.new(
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
				) * CFrame.Angles(
					math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 25),
					math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 25),
					math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 25)
				)
			end
		end

		if isAttacking then
			local atkAlpha = math.clamp((now - attackStart) / ATTACK_DURATION, 0, 1)
			local atkCurve = math.sin(atkAlpha * math.pi)
			targetRight = cf(1.30, 0.4 + atkCurve * 0.3, -0.6 - atkCurve * 0.4, 10 - atkCurve * 70, -30, 25)
			torsoTilt = torsoTilt * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(atkCurve * 25), 0)
		end

		local animSmooth = 0.25
		currTorso = currTorso:Lerp(torsoTilt, animSmooth)
		currRArm = currRArm:Lerp(targetRight, animSmooth)
		currLArm = currLArm:Lerp(targetLeft, animSmooth)
		currRLeg = currRLeg:Lerp(targetRLeg, animSmooth)
		currLLeg = currLLeg:Lerp(targetLLeg, animSmooth)

		if rootJoint and originalRootC0 then
			rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 * currTorso * shakeOffset
		end

		local bodyBase = rootPart.CFrame * currTorso

		if rightArm then
			rightArm.CFrame = bodyBase * currRArm * shakeOffset
			rightArm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
		if leftArm then
			leftArm.CFrame = bodyBase * currLArm * shakeOffset
			leftArm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
		if rightLeg then
			rightLeg.CFrame = bodyBase * currRLeg * shakeOffset
			rightLeg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
		if leftLeg then
			leftLeg.CFrame = bodyBase * currLLeg * shakeOffset
			leftLeg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		if heldSword and rightArm then
			local customGrip = CFrame.new(GripData.pX, GripData.pY, GripData.pZ) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(GripData.rX), math.rad(GripData.rY), math.rad(GripData.rZ))
			heldSword.part.CFrame = rightArm.CFrame * customGrip
			heldSword.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		if #heldSwords == 2 and not isBeyblading then
			if rightArm and leftArm then
				local customGrip = CFrame.new(GripData.pX, GripData.pY, GripData.pZ) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(GripData.rX), math.rad(GripData.rY), math.rad(GripData.rZ))
				heldSwords[1].part.CFrame = rightArm.CFrame * customGrip
				heldSwords[2].part.CFrame = leftArm.CFrame * customGrip
				heldSwords[1].part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				heldSwords[2].part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end

		for index, sword in ipairs(activeSwords) do
			if not sword.part or not sword.part.Parent then continue end
			local swingX = math.sin(now * 3 + index) * 20
			local swingZ = math.cos(now * 2.5 + index) * 15

			local offsetSide = CFrame.new(
				-1.2 - ((index - 1) * 0.15),
				-1,
				(index - 1) * 0.1
			) * CFrame.Angles(
				math.rad(swingX),
				math.rad(90),
				math.rad(-45 + swingZ)
			)

			sword.part.CFrame = bodyBase * offsetSide
			sword.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		local hatCount = #spinningHats
		for index, hat in ipairs(spinningHats) do
			if not hat.part or not hat.part.Parent then continue end
			local spinSpeed = now * 4
			local angleOffset = (index / hatCount) * math.pi * 2
			local radius = hatCount > 1 and 1.5 or 0 

			local backBase = bodyBase * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 1.3)
			local orbit = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, spinSpeed + angleOffset) * CFrame.new(0, radius, 0)
			local selfSpin = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, spinSpeed * 2)

			hat.part.CFrame = backBase * orbit * selfSpin
			hat.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end)
end
